messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER • api-gateway-prod (eu-west-1)
Severity: P1
Symptom: sudden spike in 502/504 at edge mux (fanout failures)
On-call: @Maya Chen
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-gateway-5xx
Auto-created channel: #incidents

Maya Chen: I'm awake, jumping in. Logs/metrics link? Any initial impact on premium customers?

Devon Patel: Graph: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west/api-gw/5xx -> 502 rate from 00:12->00:20 UTC +350%
Edge 502s coincide with mux fanout errors to 'inference-pools'. Upstream 504s + connection resets.

Anika Gomez: Seeing elevated p95 latency on product-search and embeddings endpoints. Customers reporting timeouts.

Maya Chen: OK. First triage:
- Confirm if this is an upstream overload vs config change
- If fanout causing cascading fail, enable fallthrough routing to spare pool
- Consider temporary circuit-breaker at mux level

Theo Rivera: Quick check: backends healthy (CPU/GPU fine). There's a sudden spike in pending connections on mux nodes.
I think one mux group lost connectivity to a subset of inference hosts -> amplified fanout failures.

MonitoringBot: Alert correlator: 72% of 502s originate from edge-mux-07 and edge-mux-09.
Recent deploy? None in last 2 hours.

Maya Chen: Action items:
1) Devon - reroute traffic for eu-west-1 to fallback mux group via infra feature flag in 5m
2) Anika - throttling rule: reduce simultaneous conn_per_client to 8 for embeddings path
3) Theo - drain edge-mux-07 and 09 and collect tcpdump/logs
4) CS - prepare customer notices for impacted tenants (IDs: t-4412, t-1187)

Devon Patel: Kicking the failover flag now: `curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/flags/failover -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","target":"mux-fallback"}'`
Response: `200 OK` - starting shift -> see drop in error rate on graph.

Maya Chen: Nice, error rate dropping ~60% in last 90s. Keep draining and monitor.

Anika Gomez: Throttling applied. p95 latency for embeddings dropping. Some queued requests being retried -> watch for retry storms.

Theo Rivera: tcpdump from mux-07 shows many RSTs to inference host pool from NAT gateway. Investigating NAT conn limits.

Customer Success Bot: Notifying CS reps for t-4412 and t-1187 with template: "We are mitigating a transient gateway error impacting API requests; engineers are working on failover. Will update in 30m." :email:

Maya Chen: Good. Tentative mitigation successful. Next:
- Keep fallback in place for 30m
- Postmortem check: why mux group lost upstream connectivity (NAT limits / infra network flapping)
- Reenable original routing only after connectivity confirmed and slow ramp

Devon Patel: Error rate stabilized near baseline. I'll keep flag live for 30m and then start canary rejoin.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. Leaving notes and will open a postmortem ticket. Adding incident timeline to pager duty.

IncidentBot: Incident status -> mitigated, severity downgraded to P2. Last observed 502s trending to normal.
